assignments.name: Set_Possible_Store_Replacement
assignments.label: Set Possible Store Replacement to true

Flow.description: SAL-431: When a CG Cloud Mobile - TSM user updates an Account and Name, ShippingStreet and ShippingCity all change in the same save, flag the record as a possible wholesale store replacement. Before-save context sets Possible_Store_Replacement__c with no extra DML and no recursion, and runs in a separate context from the after-save TPB_Send_Account_Update_Email notification flow so the two never race. Update Message: v1.0 Created (SAL-431).
Flow.interviewLabel: RT - Account - Flag Possible Store Replacement {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: RT - Account - Flag Possible Store Replacement

start.filterFormula: NOT({!$Record.Name} = {!$Record__Prior.Name}) && NOT({!$Record.ShippingStreet} = {!$Record__Prior.ShippingStreet}) && NOT({!$Record.ShippingCity} = {!$Record__Prior.ShippingCity}) && {!$Profile.Name} = 'CG Cloud Mobile - TSM'
